It was a beautiful summer day at the Sweet Sensations Bakery. The sun shone brightly through the windows, casting warm rays of light into every corner of the shop. Jessica was in the kitchen, wearing her signature pink apron, as she prepared a batch of her delicious chocolate chip cookies. She hummed softly to herself, enjoying the peacefulness of the moment.

As she measured out the ingredients, she felt her son’s gaze upon her. Turning around, she found him leaning against the doorframe, his eyes fixated on her figure. Jessica smiled coyly, knowing that her son was admiring her curves.

“Hey, sweetie,” she greeted him warmly. “What brings you to visit me today? I have a hour before I close up the shop.”

“Just wanted to see what you were up to Mom, was free and stopped over to see if you needed help” he replied, his voice laced with admiration.

Jessica felt a flutter in her chest at the sound of his voice. She loved how he always spoke to her with such respect and admiration. It made her feel desirable and wanted, which was something she had been missing since her husband’s passing.

“Well, how about you help me mix these ingredients?” she offered, winking at him playfully.

He grinned and made his way over to her, taking a spoon and joining her at the counter. Together, they mixed the dough, their hands brushing against each other’s as they worked. Jessica couldn’t help but notice the electricity that seemed to spark whenever they made contact.

As they finished mixing the dough, Jessica scooped out a spoonful and offered it to her son. He eagerly accepted, savoring the warm, gooey sweetness of the cookie.

“Mmm, these are amazing,” he complimented her, his eyes sparkling with appreciation.

Jessica beamed with pride, feeling a surge of happiness at his words. She loved nothing more than seeing her son happy, and knowing that she was the one who had brought that happiness made her heart swell with joy.
